headline: Backends, AI features and code cleanup for products that need to work in production
intro: I take on a small number of projects at a time, so each one gets real attention. Here's what I can help with.

services.title: Backend & API development
services.forWho: Founders and teams who need a reliable backend for a web or mobile product
services.summary: Clean REST APIs in Django REST Framework or FastAPI (Go when it fits), built to be tested, documented and easy to hand over.
includes: Endpoint design and PostgreSQL data model

services.title: AI chatbots & document intelligence
services.forWho: Teams with lots of documents who want answers they can trust
services.summary: Chatbots that answer from your own documents and cite their sources, built on OpenAI, Azure OpenAI or Claude, with honest accuracy testing.
includes: Search and answers over PDFs, docs and transcripts
Source citations and clear "I don't know" behaviour
API or chat widget you can plug into your product

services.title: AI-generated code cleanup
services.forWho: Makers who built a product with AI tools and now need it to be maintainable
services.summary: I review, restructure and secure code written with ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor, so it can be extended and handed to other developers.
includes: Security fixes and tests for critical paths

process.title: Discuss
process.description: We agree on the goal, scope and what "done" looks like.

process.title: Plan
process.description: A short written plan with milestones and a fair estimate.

process.title: Build
process.description: Working demos at each milestone, with regular written updates.

process.title: Hand over
process.description: Tested code, documentation and a walkthrough.
